examples.arabic: كلنا تعلمنا درس مهم: لما نتعاون ونخطط سوا، بنقدر نواجه أصعب التحديات اللي بتجينا بالحياة.
examples.english: We all learned an important lesson: when we cooperate and plan together, we can face the toughest challenges that come our way in life.
examples.transliteration: Kullna ta'allamna dars muhimm: lamma neta'aawan w nkhattet sawah, benqdar nwaaje' as'ab et-tahaddiyat illi b-tejeena bil-haya.
examples.storyTitle: The Mountain Storm: Challenges and Unity

examples.arabic: أنا، كشابّة أعمل في مجال الإعلام، أرى أن صوت الشباب مهمٌ جداً في هذه النقاشات المعقدة.
examples.english: I, as a young woman working in media, believe that the voice of youth is very important in these complex discussions.
examples.transliteration: 'Ana, ka-shabba a'mal fi majal al-i'lam, ara anna sawt al-shabab muhimmun jiddan fi hadhihi al-niqashat al-mu'aqqada.
examples.storyTitle: A Family Discussion on the Political News Broadcast

examples.arabic: امتحانا، "مشاريع التخطيط العمراني"، كتير مهم لعلاماتها النهائية وهي درستله أيام طويلة.
examples.english: Her exam, "Urban Planning Projects," is very important for her final grades, and she studied for it for many long days.
examples.transliteration: Imtihana, "Mashari' el Takhteet el 'Omrani," kteer muhimm li'alamataha en-niha'iyeh w hiye darasetlu ayyam taweeleh.

examples.arabic: اه العرس مهم و اكيد في فرح كبير بس انا عندي هدف اكبر لعملي
examples.english: Oh, the wedding is important and surely there is great joy, but I have a bigger goal for my work.
examples.transliteration: Ah, el-ers mohemm w akeed fee farah kbeer, bas ana a'andi hadaf akbar li-'amali.
examples.storyTitle: Neighbors' Talk: Between Work and Family

examples.arabic: ابو احمد حكى بفخر عن انجاز مهم حققه بشغله هالاسبوع وهالشي بفضل خبرته الطويلة
examples.english: Abu Ahmad spoke proudly about an important achievement he realized at work this week, and this was thanks to his long experience.
examples.transliteration: abu Ahmad haka bi-fakhr 'an injaaz muhimm haqqaqo bi-shughlo hal-usbu' w hal-shi bi-fadl khibrato it-taweele

examples.arabic: لارا: وهذا شي كتير مهم يا طارق، تعليم الجيل الجديد هو أساس بناء مستقبل أفضل للكل.
examples.english: Lara: And this is very important, Tareq, educating the new generation is the foundation for building a better future for everyone.
examples.transliteration: Lara: W hada shi kteer muhimm ya Tareq, ta'leem al-jeel al-jadeed huwe asas bina' mustaqbal afdal lil-kull.
